desc.bh: b/þ-like: tall stem, small hooked loop at upper right
desc.#: double-barred cross standing ON the line (not a superscript)
desc.+: single cross standing on the line (t-like)
desc.nt: n joined to a crossed stroke (looks like n+), ONE sign
desc.lam: Λ lambda: two strokes meeting at the top
desc.y: cursive y with a looped tail
desc.v: curved v with a hooked left arm (ṽ-like)
desc.w: cursive w/ω, often with a lead-in stroke from the left
desc.wd: ω joined to a tall right stroke (like "ud")
desc.e: looped e (ℓ-like), often carries # or + above
desc.Lx: Λ with a bar crossing its right leg (looks like "4" or "Λ+")
desc.[: ⊏ square box open to the RIGHT
desc.]: ⊐ square box open to the LEFT
desc.U: ⊔ square cup open at the TOP
desc.phi: φ: small slashed o on a long stem
desc.rz: low shape on the line like "ɿ2" / a lying z, left hook then wave
desc.tee: ⊢: vertical stroke with a bar to the right
desc.L: L (often a small 1 or 7 written inside the angle, which is part of the sign)
desc.dl: δ with a long tilde tail (δ~)
desc.ch: c followed by a tall looped h (che abbreviation?)
desc.p: p with loop, its stem crossed
desc.hb: ħ: h with a bar through the ascender
desc.4: 4-shape with a foot: a slash crossing a ⊥
desc.h: cursive h / b / 6 with a loop
desc.dh: ժ: stem curving left at the bottom (d-like)
desc.psi: ψ-like forked y (two arms, straight tail)
